{{Season|Winter}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 75 |Behavior = Sinker |Size = 5 - 10 in |XP = 28 |Edibility = -20 |base = 150 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at [[Stardew:The Beach|The Beach]] and the ocean side of [[Blue Moon Vineyard]] during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, and {{Season|Winter}} in any weather, between the hours of 6:00 am - 10:00 pm. It can also be caught on [[Stardew:Ginger Island|Ginger Island]] during any season. A minimum fishing level of 5 is required to catch it. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {{PAGENAME}} can be caught in any eligible ocean location. {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Beach.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || [[File:Fish Zone Blue Moon Vineyard.png|300px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|The Beach - Fishing Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Blue Moon Vineyard - Fishing Zones |} {|class="wikitable" | style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island West.png|400px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island South.png|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- | style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, west - Fishing Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, south - Fishing Zones |} {|class="wikitable" | [[File:Fish Zone Island Southeast.png|500px|class=responsive image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, southeast - Fishing Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Leo, Linus, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate=Claire, Evelyn, Haley, Martin, Pierre, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Starfish}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is required to complete the {{Bundle|ocean fish|32|y}}. If '''"Hard SVE Bundles"''' is selected, 3 Starfish are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|red}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a red color. ==History==
